part: Page composition — Capacity investment estimate (/operations/calculator), item D3
source: UI fix round 2026-09-08, operator item D3, verbatim: "'Capacity investment estimate' calculator -> its own page /operations/calculator (ruled earlier)", and "'Recent recalculations' ... REMOVE from the list". Coordinator note N4: this route has NO artboard, so the values measured here are the STANDARD FRAME's own (README §0.3) plus the structural facts the item states.
notes: No artboard exists for this route. Every expectation below is either a README §0.3 frame value or a fact the operator's item states.

'Recent recalculations' is the calculator's own foot (NoticesRail, inside AutomateVsHireCalculator), so it moves WITH the calculator rather than being deleted; the row below asserts it arrived here, and compose-08-operations-list.json's forbid asserts it left the list page.
The calculator is pure client-side compute (automate-vs-hire.mjs), so the mount needs no data fixture: the component's own DEFAULT_SCENARIO is the real product default a reader lands on.

764px is the content column this harness's 1440 mount produces (nav 252 + page padding + 28px gap + 300px rail), the same value every other compose-*.json spec measures since fold 60 — see compose-10-map.json's own note. The artboards' own column is 778; the 14px difference is the harness's frame, not a product deviation.
